title: What it is like is what it is like to be aware of the state

statements.text: There being something it is like for one to be in a state is its seeming subjectively that one is in that state. A state that is not conscious has nothing it is like to be in it, in the relevant sense, though it can still have qualitative character.

sources.quote: Knowing what it is like to be in a state is knowing what it is like to be aware of being in that state.
